# Read-only review (do NOT edit files)
Project: Android EMR (Kotlin, Compose), safety-critical. Review the working-tree diff (`git diff`) in the current directory. Intent: copy-only fixes: remove trailing exclamation marks from error/status strings, remove decorative emoji prefixes (⚡ 📷 📌 ✖), replace two em dashes with colons. Nothing else may change.
Verify: (1) every hunk is text-only inside a string literal or strings.xml value; no logic, identifier, import, format-argument or interpolation changes (compare each ${...} and %1$d before/after); (2) nothing in app/src/test or app/src/androidTest asserts the OLD text (grep for the removed strings); (3) no string lost a needed placeholder; (4) no remaining "!" at the end of error messages in SecuritySettingsDialog.kt and CatalogSettingsSections.kt; (5) ✓ ⚠️ ▲ status glyphs in clinical badges are untouched.
Output: `PASS` or `FAIL`, then findings as `path:line | severity | problem`. Max 15 lines. Quote only what you verified.
